name: kanban_delete
description: Remove a card from the board for everyone. Permanent: a deleted card cannot be brought back, because a peer that already dropped it would never learn to restore it.
llm_description: Delete a card from the board for everyone. Permanent, cannot be restored. {"id"} required (card id from kanban_list); optional "room" (defaults 'board').

room.description: Board room name; omit for the default 'board' room
